body:
my cab entry says the pasture treatment workers brushed off mustard-colored dust. not one fly remained before a cruiser waved us away.

The small ordinary expense was the part I could still account for. I could not make the other figure on this page match what I had seen.

I could have mistaken the order in which those things happened. I could not mistake the empty place left for the person we had been waiting for.
title: cab note — on the cold night
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the mustard-colored dust while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
